breakdown.description: `IBRION = -1` together with `NSW = 0` turns the run into a static calculation even though the workflow requires a structural relaxation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly changed IBRION from -1 to 2 (conjugate-gradient ionic relaxation) and NSW from 0 to 99, matching the ground truth. This properly configures the run as a structural relaxation rather than a static calculation. The specification even explicitly notes these overrides.
